caption: Page 1625 of the British Medical Journal, December 5, 1896, the opening of Weir Mitchell's "Remarks on the Effects of Anhelonium Lewinii."
alt: Printed page headed "ANHELONIUM LEWINII" with the article title "REMARKS ON THE EFFECTS OF ANHELONIUM LEWINII (THE MESCAL BUTTON)," byline "By S. Weir Mitchell, M.D., LL.D.Edin.," and the opening paragraphs describing his self-experiment.
credit: Internet Archive / British Medical Journal 2, no. 1875 (Dec. 5, 1896)
note: This bound half-year volume (item sim_british-medical-journal_july-4-december-19-1896) is 2105 leaves; leaf 1626 is the printed page numbered 1625, found via the search-inside API for "Anhelonium". The draft's textSource note records that no cleaner alternative scan of this volume could be located (PMC gated, HathiTrust 403, Google Books quota exhausted), so this is the same scan the transcript was corrected against.
